spec_section_updates.section_4: Post-dev-fix-pass QA cycle (2026-05-18). All 6 Must-Have blockers inspected in react_template.tpl (2712 lines). Partial implementations confirmed for B1-B5; B6 remains incomplete. Key measurements: EDITOR_MODE count=0 (AC1 OK); /api/route call present at line 2224 (B1 partial); slot-drop onClick present in KanbanView (B2 partial); accommodation cover-image merge code present at lines 1791-1812 (B3 partial); KanbanView board-drag draggable={isSelected} present at lines 859,936,1009,1079 (B4 partial); _isCompatible called in onDrop handlers (B5 partial); skipped/required-empty badges in KanbanView (B6 partial). Critical defects: (1) slot adjacency order at line 2337 is wrong (breakfast,lunch,dinner,morning,afternoon,evening instead of chronological order); (2) KanbanView signature at line 718 missing editorSelections from destructuring, causing required-empty badge to always render false; (3) TimelineView (line 1409) receives no editor props — AC14/AC17/AC18 TimelineView requirements unmet; (4) accommodation options never rendered in CandidatesSidebar — B3/AC15 UI path missing.
spec_section_updates.section_6: None of the 6 Must-Have blockers fully resolved. B1: route fetch fires but slot adjacency order is chronologically incorrect (line 2337 uses meals-first order, not chronological). B2: KanbanView onClick present but TimelineView has no tap handler — AC14 requires BOTH. B3: merge logic correct but accommodation candidates not shown in sidebar — no UI path to trigger cover-image update. B4: KanbanView board-drag present but TimelineView has no draggable placed cards — AC17 requires BOTH views. B5: _isCompatible in onDrop but TimelineView absent and onDragOver has no compatibility gate — AC18 requires all interactions. B6: skipped/required-empty partial; missing-state, late-arrival, data-droppable=false absent; editorSelections destructuring bug at line 718 means required-empty logic always reads {} instead of actual selections.
spec_section_updates.section_7: Required fixes for next dev cycle: (1) Fix slot adjacency order at line 2337: change filter array to ['morning_activity', 'breakfast', 'afternoon_activity', 'lunch', 'evening_activity', 'dinner'] matching NAMED_SLOTS chronological order in web/js/state.js. (2) Add editorSelections to KanbanView destructuring at line 718. (3) Add editor interactions to TimelineView: tap handler for AC14, draggable placed cards for AC17, _isCompatible for AC18. (4) Render accommodation options in CandidatesSidebar so users can select accommodation and trigger cover-image update (B3/AC15). (5) Add missing-state badge (slot key absent from effectiveDay), late-arrival badge (slot.late_arrival_placeholder===true), and set data-droppable=false for gated slots (AC22).

all_findings.issue: B1/AC12+AC23: Slot adjacency order for route fetching is chronologically incorrect. Array is [breakfast, lunch, dinner, morning_activity, afternoon_activity, evening_activity] (meals-first). Should be [morning_activity, breakfast, afternoon_activity, lunch, evening_activity, dinner] (chronological per NAMED_SLOTS in web/js/state.js). Route pairs computed between wrong consecutive slots.
all_findings.recommendation: Change the filter array order at line 2337 to match chronological NAMED_SLOTS order.

all_findings.issue: B2/AC14 + B4/AC17 + B5/AC18: TimelineView component receives only display props (day, bp, lang, mapProvider, onItemClick). No editor props passed: no pendingSelection, no applyEditorSelection, no draggable placed cards, no _isCompatible. All three ACs require TimelineView interaction support.
all_findings.recommendation: Add editor props to TimelineView signature and call site. Implement tap-to-select, board-drag, and _isCompatible enforcement in TimelineView.

all_findings.issue: B3/AC15: Accommodation options not rendered in CandidatesSidebar. Users cannot select a different accommodation option, making the cover-image merge code (lines 1791-1812) unreachable via normal user interaction.
all_findings.recommendation: Add accommodation section to CandidatesSidebar showing editorDay.accommodation.options as draggable/tappable cards.

all_findings.issue: B6/AC22: editorSelections missing from KanbanView destructuring. KanbanView closes over editorSelections as undefined (always {}), causing required-empty badge logic at line 895 to always evaluate against {} instead of actual selections. Slots filled via editorSelections appear required-empty.
all_findings.recommendation: Add editorSelections to KanbanView destructuring at line 718.

all_findings.issue: B6/AC22: Missing-state badge (slot key absent from effectiveDay entirely) not implemented. Late-arrival badge (slot.late_arrival_placeholder === true) not implemented. data-droppable=false not set for skipped or missing slots — all slot-drop divs are unconditionally droppable.
all_findings.recommendation: Add missing-state check: if slot key not in effectiveDay, render missing badge and set data-droppable=false. Add late-arrival check: if slot.late_arrival_placeholder===true, render late-arrival badge. Set data-droppable=false for gated slots.

all_findings.issue: B5/AC18: onDragOver handler sets data-drag-over attribute unconditionally without _isCompatible pre-check. Visual feedback (highlight) shown even for incompatible drops. AC18 requires compatibility enforcement on ALL interactions.
all_findings.recommendation: Add _isCompatible check in onDragOver; only set data-drag-over if compatible (and have the dragged slot id available in the event, e.g., from dataTransfer).
